title: k-Core
description: This plugin will help you shorten Placeholders to be more concise, not cumbersome but still display full functions.
body:
**Is a high performance plugin.​**

- This plugin will help you shorten Placeholders to be more concise, not cumbersome but still display full functions.

You can find a shortened list of placeholders in: plugins/kCore/data/placeholder_core.yml

![List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a831b3dc23a5e8d6a89d2f0a005df5a5f7dd4039_0.webp)

Display plugin information, TPS, plugin list, and some other information on chat when admin joins the server.

![Info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/834ddb9472a9c3c59537269ab9441ff14d6f92c2.webp)

Load and display the list of plugins loaded in the server into a plugin.yml file and can enable or disable plugins directly on the chat.

![List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0c193a07b85557167aeb78bcfead78a2018521f.webp)
​
- Note: Disabling a plugin and re-enabling it can cause errors, I don't recommend enabling it directly from my k-Core plugin if you are sure that there are no errors after enabling a plugin, I have tried with some other plugins and some require reloading the server or using the same command in the plugin to work smoothly. ( you don't want your server console to have confusing text, so don't use this direct enable function if you don't want those errors to appear ).
  


Command to use​

/kcore​ Show list of active plugins on server​

/kcore ( Plugin name ) on | off​ Enable, disable a plugin​

/kcore help​ Open command help​

My plugin is open source, and make sure you agree to my terms of use.

Github: k-Core
Discord: KaliStudio
